newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Evander busy in bookover dominated trade.
newsitem.headline: Evander busy in bookover dominated trade.

text.p: South African mining firm Evander Ltd jumped in early morning trade in heavy dealings dominated by a single bookover deal, dealers said on Monday.

By 0755 GMT the stock had added 150 cents to 25.00 rand in trade of 2.18 million shares worth 54.4 million rand. About two million of the shares came in a bookover deal from brokers Capital Alliance Securities.
A Capital Alliance Securities dealer confirmed the bookover deal -- where one broker matches both buyer and seller -- but declined to give further details.
Evander is part of the Gencor stable and is South Africa's seventh largest gold mine.
The mine had a gold output of 4,930 kg of gold in the quarter to end-March, against 4,472 in the previous quarter.
